# Ravenhill Estate

> Ravenhill Estate is a 46-acre 1840s estate in Rhinebeck, New York, with a restored stone barn seating 220, a heated glass orangery seating 90, and a west-facing river meadow for ceremonies of up to 260.

- Phone: +1-845-555-0126
- Address: 1820 River Road, Rhinebeck, NY, 12572
- Hours: Mon/Tue/Wed/Thu/Fri 09:00 to 17:00; Sat 10:00 to 14:00
- Rating: 4.9 from 134 reviews
